import glob, subprocess, time, re
start=time.monotonic(); prev=None; changes=[]; samples=0; max_wch=0; unprotected_seen=set()
while time.monotonic()-start < 60:
    p=subprocess.run(['ioreg','-p','IOUSB','-l','-w','0'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
    txt=p.stdout
    wch=len(re.findall(r'\"idVendor\" = 6790',txt))
    max_wch=max(max_wch,wch)
    ports=tuple(sorted(glob.glob('/dev/cu.usbserial-*')+glob.glob('/dev/cu.wchusbserial*')+glob.glob('/dev/cu.SLAB_USBtoUART*')+glob.glob('/dev/cu.usbmodem*')))
    unprotected=tuple(x for x in ports if not x.rsplit('/',1)[-1].endswith('10'))
    unprotected_seen.update(unprotected)
    state=(wch,ports)
    if state!=prev:
        changes.append((round(time.monotonic()-start,2),wch,ports))
        prev=state
    samples+=1
    time.sleep(0.5)
print('USB_FLAP_SAMPLES',samples)
print('MAX_WCH_USB_DEVICES',max_wch)
print('UNPROTECTED_PORTS_SEEN',sorted(unprotected_seen))
print('STATE_CHANGES_BEGIN')
for row in changes: print(row)
print('STATE_CHANGES_END')
print('FINAL_PORTS',prev[1] if prev else ())
